title: react-instantsearch release goals
body:
With the work done by @Morhaus on instantsearch + react, we are on the road to releasing it.
## Goals
- provide a set of React components as a separate library (`react-instantsearch` in npm). With a beta testing phase.
- allow people to reuse widget logic to create different implementation of our widgets (via HOC/connect-like in `react-instantsearch`)
- the default behavior of widgets should be to keep the user refinements visible even if they are no more relevant (#962 #840 #1152 #1260)
- allow people to manually feed some widget with data (example: "I want a menu with those 5 colors"), #1062 
- change the API and/or implementation of some complex widgets (currentRefinementValues for example), check those `widget:nameOfWidget` labels in github
- create a nice website to document the library, publish it at community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react
- the website should be focused on widget pages and a guide with a progressive learning curve (much like the helper website)

The current working branch is in v2.

I will create some issues and label them v2 so we can work on them.
